description: The denominator, and the one defect in this tree that is not a defect in the package: nothing here is wrong except that the point has nothing to read. Angular's compilation is what makes a template visible in the artefact, so the day it changes shape — a different mode, a bundler that stores templates elsewhere — every pattern of point 8 would match nothing and the gate would report a package with no animation binding, which is also what it reports when it cannot see one (`lesson-48`).
